scope: offline schema fixture, not production performance acceptance
query: WITH scopes AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.account, json_extract(a.payload,'$.contract.con_id') AS con_id FROM te_jobs j JOIN te_attempts a ON a.job_id=j.id WHERE j.ticker=? AND j.leg='ENTRY'), scoped_fills AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.account,f.family,f.correction,f.payload,f.attempt_id FROM scopes s JOIN te_fills f ON f.account=s.account AND f.con_id=s.con_id ), families AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.account,f.family FROM scoped_fills f WHERE julianday(json_extract(f.payload,'$.time'))>=julianday(?) AND julianday(json_extract(f.payload,'$.time'))<julianday(?)) SELECT f.account,f.family,f.correction,f.payload,f.attempt_id, j.leg,e.ticker,e.payload AS execution FROM scoped_fills f JOIN families c ON f.account=c.account AND f.family=c.family LEFT JOIN te_attempts a ON a.id=f.attempt_id LEFT JOIN te_jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id LEFT JOIN te_executions e ON e.id=j.execution_id
steps: SEARCH f USING INDEX te_fills_scope (account=? AND con_id=?)
SEARCH f USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (account=? AND family=?)
SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_te_attempts_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH j USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_te_jobs_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH e USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_te_executions_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
